file_id: Pappu Jaya Kumar Alias Kumar, vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh, on 2 September, 2020

sentences.text: Pappu Jaya Kumar Alias Kumar, vs The State Of Andhra

Author: D.Ramesh Bench: D.Ramesh  THE HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE D.RAMESH  Criminal Petition No.3558 OF 2020 Order: (Heard and pronounced through Blue Jeans App (virtual) mode,
since this mode is adopted on account of prevalence of COVID-19 Pandemic)
 This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 of Cr.P.C to quash the proceedings in Crime No.268 of 2020, dated 29.08.2020 of Gangavaram Police Station, Chittoor District against the petitioner/A-3 for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 270, 273 and 328 of the Indian Penal Code,
Section 24(1) r/w 27 of Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products Act, 2003, Section 3 of Epidemic Disease Act, Section 59(i) of Food Safety and Standards Act and Section 4 of Gutkha Pan Masala Prohibition Act.
2.

entities.text: Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products Act, 2003
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Heard the counsel for the petitioner and the Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent-State.

3. Both the counsel submit that the issue involved in this petition is squarely covered by the order dated 27.08.2018,
passed by this Court in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018 and batch.

4. In view of the above and in terms of the aforementioned Pappu Jaya Kumar Alias Kumar, vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh, on 2 September, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/81043918/
1 order, this Criminal petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioner in Crime No. 268 of 2020, dated 29.08.2020 of Gangavaram Police Station, Chittoor District are hereby quashed.
